title: One Word Friendsgiving
trend: Friendsgiving prep week (#friendsgiving Rising, SocialPilot TikTok cultural moments Nov 21-25 2026; Thanksgiving Nov 26, US) as an 'answer in one word' interview skit — host Priya bans long answers at her Friendsgiving because Ben's toast last year lasted forty minutes; she quizzes guests in one word (turkey, store-bought pie, the broken gravy boat) while Ben cannot do it and quiet Wes is perfect; twist: her last question, what are you thankful for, gets Wes's one word: Priya — with a ring in the pie; button: she answers yes, Ben asks to give a toast — no
youtube_title: At my Friendsgiving you can only answer in one word 🦃
description:
Priya has one rule at Friendsgiving this year: answer in one word. Ben has never said one word in his life. Wes has never said two. Then comes the last question.

lines.text: Welcome to Friendsgiving. One rule this year. You can only answer in one word.
Okay but quick question, does a word with a dash count as one word?
That was fourteen words, Ben.
Sorry.
Last year your toast was forty minutes. The turkey got cold. The candles went out.
It was a good toast.
Four words. Wes, show him how it is done. Wes, how was the drive?
Fine.
Beautiful. Ben, how was your drive?
Long. Traffic. Okay that was two. Long.
Question one. The turkey. One word.
Juicy.
Juicy-ish.
Ish is not a word.
It is a feeling. The middle was juicy. The leg was a little bit like a shoe.
You just told me my turkey was a shoe in seventeen words.
A nice shoe.
Question two. Who brought a pie from the store and put it in my good dish?
Ben.
Wes! You are supposed to be on my side.
One.
One what?
Word.
The pie still had the sticker on it, Ben. Half off.
It was half off because it was a half. It was a very expensive half.
Question three. Who broke my gravy boat?
Nobody broke it. It is resting. In two pieces. Near the sink.
That is a broken gravy boat.
It is a gravy canoe now. It is smaller. More personal.
Wes, what happened to the gravy boat?
Ben.
Every single answer is Ben. That is so unfair. I am a guest.
Last question. And it is the important one. What are you thankful for?
Okay. Here is the thing. I am thankful for friends, and the turkey, and also.
Ben.
Pie.
Good. Wes. What are you thankful for?
Priya.
Oh. That is a very good word.
Wait. Why is there something shiny in the store pie?
Wes. Is that a ring? In the half off pie?
Surprise.
That is why you said I brought the pie! You hid it in my pie!
Yes.
He said Ben every time to protect the ring. That is the nicest thing anyone has done with my name.
Priya. Will you?
Yes.
One word. She did it in one word. I am going to cry for forty minutes.
Can I give a toast?
No.
No.
